details.description: Base Phonecall is a Deepgram speech-to-text model in Deepgram's Base tier, tuned specifically for low-bandwidth telephone audio rather than general-purpose recordings. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview lists Base, together with Enhanced and Nova 1, under "Legacy Models", and supports it for English only. It is built on Deepgram's end-to-end deep learning speech recognition architecture.
advantages: Tuned specifically for low-bandwidth telephone call audio, unlike Deepgram's general-purpose Base model.
Deepgram describes Base-tier models as offering a combination of accuracy and cost-effectiveness built on its end-to-end deep learning speech-to-text architecture.
disadvantages: Deepgram lists the Base tier under "Legacy Models" in its Models & Languages Overview.
Deepgram describes its Enhanced tier as having higher accuracy and better word recognition than Base models, including significantly better handling of uncommon words.
Supports English only, per Deepgram's language documentation.
use_cases: Transcribing telephone call recordings (e.g. call centers, phone-based customer service)

notes: No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures specific to base-phonecall were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. Legacy status: developers.deepgram.com/docs/model does not use the word, but developers.deepgram.com/docs/models-languages-overview groups Nova (1), Enhanced and Base under a 'Legacy Models' heading (re-checked 2026-09-24 after the fact-check pass removed the claim). The catalog carries no deprecation_date.
